questions.question: Name the seven life processes.
questions.expected_answer: Feeding, growing, reproducing, breathing, excreting, sensing and moving.

questions.question: Explain how a tree feeds and breathes.
questions.expected_answer: A tree makes its own food in its leaves using sunlight. It takes in air through tiny holes in its leaves.

questions.question: Why do we say that plants are living things even though they cannot walk?
questions.expected_answer: Plants carry out all seven life processes. They feed, grow, reproduce, breathe, excrete, sense and move, but they move slowly, for example by turning their leaves towards the light and growing their roots.
